summary: Learn graph analytics for fraud with hands-on network analysis, risk scoring, and investigation workflows. Enquire about training now.
lede: Graph analytics for fraud, risk and network analysis helps you connect accounts, devices, merchants, and counterparties to reveal patterns that isolated transaction reviews can miss. Learn to use network mapping, entity resolution, centrality measures, community detection, and anomaly scoring to identify suspicious relationships and prioritize investigations. Build practical skills for turning transactional and entity data into explainable fraud decisions, including network diagrams, risk heatmaps, alert rules, and case summaries. Through realistic datasets and analytical exercises, the course supports repeatable workflows for faster investigation, stronger case evidence, and more informed risk triage.
audienceIntro: This graph analytics for fraud, risk and network analysis course is designed for professionals who need to investigate connected fraud patterns, prioritize risk, and produce defensible analytical outputs.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with fraud monitoring, risk review, or investigative reporting, and a basic understanding of spreadsheets and business data. Prior experience with SQL, graph concepts, or BI dashboards is helpful but not required. Delivery note: no coding is required for completion, although some exercises may introduce graph queries conceptually and at operational level. Advanced graph database engineering will be covered only at conceptual and operational application level, not production-deployment depth.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
